rounds.finding: Compound T6 power and execution raises the ceiling about 40 percent above T5; support cooldowns cannot be judged from the potency percentage alone.
rounds.revision: Keep the proposed meaningful T6 gap and require paired real-combat comparisons plus long multi-battery traces.

rounds.finding: Adding optional T6 chance risks changing old seed results or stealing the probability mass of T4 and T5 attributes; broad statistical tolerance could miss this regression.
rounds.revision: Default only undefined to zero, reject invalid rates and totals, verify old and zero profiles against 20000 baseline cases, and tighten fixed-seed rate tolerances.

rounds.finding: Tier6 furnace cooldown 2 increased support opportunities but did not consistently improve harvesting speed.
rounds.revision: Compare cooldown 3 with charge cap 80 while preserving all older power tiers and legacy resonance. Also compare the same winning seeds directly between candidates.

rounds.finding: The charge-80 candidate gives a clear single-use benefit without increasing AI support frequency, with no old-tier combat outcome changes in the sampled 1050 cases.
rounds.revision: Adopt furnace cooldown 3 / charge cap 80; keep rewind cooldown 2 and sleep cooldown 4 with extra 45 self charge. Review backup, UI, per-attribute rates and derived tower access hint again.

limitations: Finite fixed-party policies do not prove universal improvement or optimal builds.
Conditional per-attribute probabilities differ from overall item and per-run probabilities.
Waiting estimates are not measured play time, adopted upgrades or enjoyment.
